description: Paid endpoint ($0.01): Hyperliquid 1-minute OHLCV history: up to 4,320 bars (72h) per call, hours=1-72 or from/to. Hyperliquid's API keeps only the latest 5,000 1m bars; cryptofeed402 archives 1m bars for top perps so older windows (up to 30 days) are served and coverage is stated. Overlays OKX per-minute liquidations and cascades for 14 coins. Bad params 400, unknown/uncovered 404, upstream 503, no charge. Returns the x402 payment requirements and URL.

from.description: ISO-8601 or unix ms (with to; max 72h)

symbol.description: Hyperliquid perp, e.g. BTC or HIP-3 xyz:TSLA

name: get_hl_history_1m
title: Hyperliquid 1m history + liquidation overlay (paid, x402) — $0.01

x402.behavior: Tool returns x402 payment requirements + URL; caller pays over HTTP with own wallet. Charged only on HTTP 200.
